Reviewed at 1x and 4x. IT order 0..15; 16..31 transparent. Door anchor is bottom-center boundary of NOREN_DOOR tile 12 in atlas coordinates. Fictional interior, no text. Source crops assembled in IT order with nearest-neighbour 16x16 downscale; generated floor quadrants mirrored to guarantee matching opposite edges (0,1,8); wall left half mirrored horizontally. Shared export palette quantized to 23 opaque colors plus transparency, alpha threshold 128. Counter source cropped continuously and split at x449, no separating end walls. Integration of authored rooms and portal rendering belongs to #5; asset registry and pipeline metadata merge belong to #1. Ground tiles 0,1,2,3,6,7,8,12 stretched from their opaque bbox to fill the full 16x16 cell (the generated sheet left transparent gutters, which showed as grid gaps in game).

Agent visual review at 1x and 4x. Fixed T indices 0..31; 32..47 transparent. Tree quadrants 17,18,19,20 reconstruct one 32x32 tree. Collision remains map-owned. Source v1 generated, v2 edited to remove tree seams and improve ground. Crop boxes remove generated gutters and ground borders. Palette sampled from generated source regions to retain green, red, blue, cream, brown and slate; visually matched against building references. Manifest and loader integration belongs to #1. Export source is the assembled 128x96 atlas (built from rawSource via export.cropBoxesByRuntimeIndex); tools/art/export.mjs re-quantizes it 1:1.
